title: theory_mono-repo: the addressability programme
description:
The canonical record of one theory, written as four documents that share a single inequality, D-1 dS(u,v) − K ≤ dM(addr u, addr v), and of the reference frame it licenses. Everything here is either a theorem (machine-checked in Lean 4 where the kernel reaches, cited where it does not), a registered measurement (registration dated before its data, verdict scored by the registered rule, readings kept separate), or a named open question.

Contents: Paper I, The Addressability Limit; Paper II, Evolution as Active Geometry: Descent Under the Addressability Limit; the note, The Structured Addressability Limit; the BRF2026 datum specification sheet (draft 0.1); the Lean 4 modules added to the kernel sentry-bio/addressability-limit; the registered record, PREREG00 to 25, with its ledger.

Licences: MIT for the Lean code and scripts; CC BY 4.0 for the papers, registrations and documentation; CC BY-SA 4.0 for files that contain GTDB-derived trees or labels. The mapping by directory is in LICENSES.md.
